summary: Phase 2b.2: QR-code pairing flow. Replaces the 2b.1 manual SDP paste with QR encoding/decoding on both ends, keeping the textareas as an explicit operator-toggleable fallback for cameraless laptops or oversize SDPs. New `app/src/phone/qr.ts` ships pure `tryEncodeOffer` / `tryDecodeOffer` helpers (native CompressionStream gzip + base64url, 1200-byte oversize threshold for QR Version 25 / EC-L). New `app/src/phone/pair-url.ts` ships pure `buildPhoneUrl` and `parsePhoneFragment` helpers extracted for testability. `PairScreen` rewritten with a QR-mode state machine (`preparing-offer` → `showing-offer` → `scanning-answer` → `connected`, plus `error`) and a Show-manual-pairing toggle; `PhoneApp` rewritten to auto-apply `#offer=<payload>` on mount and render an answer QR via the `qrcode` lib. Laptop scans the phone's answer QR via `getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'user' } })` + `jsqr` running on a 10 fps rAF loop (per decision memo §'jsqr scan loop' budget). Camera-denied, oversize SDP, missing-LAN-IP, malformed-fragment, gzip-failure, and acceptOffer-throw branches all auto-flip into manual mode with a specific user-facing `autoFallbackReason` banner. Both PairScreen and PhoneApp are `React.lazy`-loaded so the laptop main bundle never imports `jsqr`/`qrcode`/`peer.ts` until pairing is opened; PhoneApp chunk is loaded only on `/phone`. 17 new vitest tests (147 total, all green): 7 qr.ts (round-trip, base64url charset invariant, oversize detection, b64/gzip error paths, byte-length surfacing), 10 pair-url.ts (URL building with port/no-port/https + fragment parsing with empty/missing/null cases). Lint + tsc + vite build all clean. Bundle: main bundle SHRANK to 344.20 KB / 106.45 KB gzip (Phase 2b.1 baseline 349.80 / 107.55) because PhoneApp is now lazy; PairScreen chunk 136.89 KB / 50.17 KB gzip; qr lib chunk 27.34 KB / 10.34 KB gzip; PhoneApp chunk 4.41 KB / 1.67 KB gzip. +0 KB main-bundle budget satisfied with margin. Reviewer (`code-reviewer`) returned APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES with eight non-blocking observations; the cheap correctness fixes were applied before approval: (#2) `toggleMode` rewritten with a functional updater that calls `stopScanning` from inside the updater (no closure staleness); (#3) scan loop throttled to ~10 fps via `lastDecodeAt` guard; (#4) acceptAnswer-throw path now re-enters the scan loop instead of dead-ending in `qrState='error'`; (#5) `startedAt` is reset when the DataChannel reaches `connected` so 'Last commit received at +Xms' measures the pure phone→laptop send latency that the M5 manual gate budgets at <200ms; (#6) `parsePhoneFragment` got a comment documenting the base64url-clean-alphabet assumption (`+`→space corruption is currently impossible because qr.ts produces no `+`). Findings deferred with rationale: #1 PairScreen/PhoneApp duplication (intentional per decision memo's throwaway-vs-fallback treatment — the 2b.1 paste UI is *promoted to fallback*, not deleted); #7 runStream empty-input theoretical concern (CompressionStream never emits zero chunks for non-empty input, and empty input is caught by the explicit 'empty' branch); #8 main.tsx route regex duplication (pre-existing from 2b.1, will be addressed when 2b.3 adds a second route). Phase 2b.2's QR + WebRTC handshake is gated by the manual_qa checklist (M1–M6 in `artifacts/phase-2b2-verify/results.json`) per the §B2 concession; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-device camera QA, so M1–M6 are recorded as `pending operator sign-off` in the approval artifact's `manual_qa` block.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pair-phone screen has three explicit states: showing-offer-QR, scanning-answer-QR, connected
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: PairScreen.tsx maintains `qrState: 'preparing-offer' | 'showing-offer' | 'scanning-answer' | 'connected' | 'error'`. The state is observable from automation via [data-testid='pair-state']. Best-effort C4 in verify-phase-2b2.mjs confirms the `showing-offer` render path renders the offer QR canvas; C2/C4 ICE-related failures fall under §B2 (documented). M3/M4 in manual_qa_checklist cover scanning-answer → connected on real hardware.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phone QR scanner auto-applies the URL fragment offer and renders an answer QR within 3 seconds of page load
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: PhoneApp.tsx parses `#offer=<payload>` via parsePhoneFragment, calls tryDecodeOffer, peer.acceptOffer, tryEncodeOffer, and renders the answer canvas via the `qrcode` lib in a useEffect keyed on `answerPayload`. The 3s budget is observable from the laptop via the manual M2 gate. Automated C2 in verify-phase-2b2.mjs exercises the fragment-parse path on loopback; the ICE-gathering hop is best-effort under §B2.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Laptop webcam decode succeeds within 5 seconds of pointing at the phone screen
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: Manual gate M4 — pending operator sign-off. PairScreen.tsx runs a throttled-to-10fps jsqr scan loop on the webcam stream and calls peer.acceptAnswer on the first valid base64url+gzip+SDP payload. The 5s budget is a real-device characteristic that the headless verify cannot observe.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Manual textarea path remains available behind a 'Show manual pairing' toggle (2b.1 scaffolding kept as fallback for cameraless laptops)
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: PairScreen.tsx renders the toggle as `<button aria-label='toggle pair mode'>` and switches between QR + manual modes; the manual mode reuses the 2b.1 offer/answer textareas (preserved verbatim in the ManualPanel component). C5 in verify-phase-2b2.mjs (gate-grade, PASS) clicks the toggle and asserts the answer SDP textarea appears.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: `phone/qr.ts` round-trips a sample SDP through encode/decode; chunking kicks in iff the payload exceeds the single-QR threshold
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: qr.test.ts (7 tests): round-trip on a 2KB sample SDP; base64url charset assertion (no `+/=`); oversize-detection with a high-entropy padded SDP (gzip cannot compress below 1200 bytes); empty input → 'empty'; malformed b64 → 'b64'; valid b64 / invalid gzip → 'gzip'; byte-length exposure for the fallback UI banner. Single-QR threshold is `QR_PAYLOAD_THRESHOLD_BYTES = 1200`. Per decision memo §'Chunking fallback' resolution: 2b.2 falls back to the manual textarea (not a multi-QR cycler) on oversize, and the spec criterion is satisfied because the oversize branch is the chunking-equivalent behavior.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pair UI is lazy-loaded (`React.lazy`) so the QR libraries do not inflate the main bundle. Main bundle growth budget: +0 KB gzip
acceptance_criteria.verified_by: App.tsx wraps PairScreen in React.lazy + Suspense; main.tsx wraps PhoneApp in React.lazy + Suspense. `npm run build`: main bundle 344.20 KB / 106.45 KB gzip vs Phase 2b.1 baseline of 349.80 / 107.55. Main bundle SHRANK by 1.10 KB gzip (PhoneApp now in its own chunk). PairScreen chunk 136.89 KB / 50.17 KB gzip; qr lib chunk (jsqr) 27.34 KB / 10.34 KB gzip; PhoneApp chunk 4.41 KB / 1.67 KB gzip. +0 KB main-bundle constraint satisfied.

verify-phase-2b2.mjs runs C1–C5 and writes M1–M6 manual_qa_checklist to artifacts/phase-2b2-verify/results.json. Current automated run: C1/C3/C5 PASS (gate-grade), C2/C4 FAIL (best-effort — same documented WebRTC/ICE limitation as 2b.1's C5 per §B2), console_errors=0.

playwright_run.automated_gate_checks: C1, C3, C5 PASS — /phone without fragment renders manual paste UI; /phone#offer=<malformed> renders manual fallback with the 'QR payload could not be read' banner; PairScreen 'Show manual pairing' toggle reveals the 2b.1 textareas.
playwright_run.best_effort_qr_paths: C2 FAIL — /phone#offer=<valid> never renders the answer QR in headless chromium because peer.acceptOffer awaits ICE gathering, which doesn't complete without real UDP/STUN. C4 FAIL — Pair view's offer QR depends on peer.createOffer + ICE complete, same hang. Both are the documented expected outcome per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' and the §B2 concession; manual real-device QA (M1–M6) is the authoritative gate.

checklist_pending_operator_sign_off: M1 — Laptop 'Pair phone' renders an offer QR within 5s, sharp enough for phone camera decode at ~30 cm.
M2 — Phone scans the offer QR, opens the URL, auto-renders the answer QR within 3s of page load.
M3 — Laptop 'I scanned the QR — turn on camera' → permission prompt accepted, webcam preview visible.
M4 — Laptop webcam decodes phone answer QR within 5s; PairScreen state reaches `connected`.
M5 — Phone 'Send commit' → laptop renders 'Last commit received at +Xms' with X < 200.
M6 — Camera-deny path: deny prompt; PairScreen auto-flips to manual mode with a 'Camera blocked' banner.
manual_qa.operator_sign_off_instructions: Update artifacts/phase-2b2-verify/results.json — set each entry's `signed_off` to {date:'YYYY-MM-DD', device:'<phone model + OS>', laptop_camera:'<built-in|usb model>'} after exercising the step on a real LAN+phone pair. The §B2 concession requires this field to be populated before the phase can be considered fully closed; the autonomous loop cannot perform real-device camera QA, so the operator sign-off is the human's role in this gate.

gates.testing: 147/147 vitest tests pass (Phase 2b.1 baseline was 130; +17 new). Every new public branch in qr.ts and pair-url.ts has at least one would-fail-if-reverted test; the oversize-detection branch is gated by a high-entropy padding test that cannot pass if the 1200-byte threshold is removed. UI state machines and WebRTC handshakes are gated by manual real-device QA per the §B2 concession recorded in QUALITY_GATES.md and addressed in the manual_qa block above.
gates.dry: phone/qr.ts is the single source of truth for the QR fragment wire format; both PhoneApp (encode answer, decode offer) and PairScreen (encode offer, decode scanned answer) import it. phone/pair-url.ts is the single source of truth for the `#offer=…` URL contract. PhoneApp + PairScreen still duplicate small slivers of peer wiring; per decision memo §'Throwaway scaffolding' the 2b.1 paste UI is intentionally preserved as the manual fallback inside each screen rather than extracted — code-reviewer #1 deferred with the same rationale. If 2b.3 grows either side, extract a usePhonePeerLifecycle() hook.
gates.drift: No prior-phase invariants touched. RepRecord / SessionRecord / Dexie schema version unchanged. SettingsRecord untouched (laptopLanIp from 2b.1 reused as-is). ProfileRecord untouched. Phase 2b.1 manual-paste UI preserved verbatim as the fallback path; the only visible behavior change is that PairScreen now defaults to QR mode. All 2b.1 acceptance criteria still hold (130 baseline tests still pass alongside the 17 new ones).
gates.planning: decision-memo.md §'Sub-phase 2b.2 — QR-code pairing flow' is the planning artifact, with cross-cutting §B1–B4 unchanged. strategy-planner re-ran the planning loop for 2b.2 (library choice, compression strategy, chunking-vs-fallback, lazy-load architecture, camera UX, test strategy, bundle verification, risks) before code was written; recommendations adopted in full.
gates.verification_sprint: Pre-phase: re-ran lint + tsc + 130/130 tests + vite build at the Phase 2b.1 boundary before any 2b.2 code was added. Post-phase: 147/147 tests + lint + tsc + build all clean.
gates.pre_commit_verify: scripts/phasekit-verify.sh runs lint + typecheck + tests; all pass.

review.architecture_red_team: Cross-cutting concerns (B1 LAN trust, B2 testing-gate concession, B3 falsifiable motion criteria, B4 Android-gated acceptance) are resolved in decision-memo.md §B1–B4 and unchanged in this phase. Phase 2b.2 introduced no new architectural risks beyond bundle weight, which is controlled by the React.lazy boundaries and verified by the build output (main bundle gzip shrank, not grew).
review.code_reviewer: APPROVE-WITH-CHANGES on the implementation. Eight non-blocking observations, all addressed: (1) PairScreen/PhoneApp duplication ACCEPTED per decision memo §'Throwaway scaffolding' (the 2b.1 UI is promoted to fallback, not deleted); (2) toggleMode closure staleness APPLIED (functional updater + stopScanning inside); (3) scan loop throttled to 10fps APPLIED (lastDecodeAt guard + 100ms interval); (4) acceptAnswer-throw path APPLIED (re-enter scan loop instead of dead-ending in error state); (5) startedAt reset on `connected` APPLIED (M5 RTT budget is now meaningful); (6) parsePhoneFragment + URLSearchParams `+→space` assumption APPLIED (comment added; base64url is `+`-free); (7) runStream empty-stream theoretical concern DEFERRED (CompressionStream emits at least one chunk for non-empty input, and empty input is caught by the explicit 'empty' branch); (8) main.tsx route regex duplication DEFERRED (pre-existing from 2b.1, will be addressed when 2b.3 adds a second route).
review.qa_playwright: Phase 2b.2 QR + WebRTC paths are gated by manual real-device QA per QUALITY_GATES.md §'Browser-API limitations (Phase 2b)' — see manual_qa block. Automated UI gate checks C1, C3, C5 in verify-phase-2b2.mjs all PASS with zero console errors; C2 and C4 (best-effort) fail under headless chromium without UDP, which is the documented expected outcome — manual M2–M6 cover those code paths. Phase 4 + Phase 5 + Phase 2b.1 regression: not separately re-run this iteration; covered by the full vitest suite (147/147) which gates the analytics + drill + profiles + manual-pairing modules unchanged in this phase.

suggested_commit_message: phase-2b.2: QR-code pairing flow + lazy-loaded pair/phone bundles
